The '''H'gaard Park Towers''' was an elite [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It overlooked [[Figg Plaza]], and one of its long-term residents was the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]] [[Trix-sor]].
